counter: unicode-codepoints-v1; len(serialized input); not a model tokenizer
serialization: JSON; ensure_ascii=False; separators comma/colon; insertion order template, instruction, example, evidence, question
selection: Explicit topic and half-open validity interval; no label or query ID lookup
ordering: Valid-from descending then source ID; full evidence blocks only
compression: Only exact source-line selection with source/version/range retained; never lose amount, unit or validity
failure: Return context_budget if any required evidence does not fit; never silently discard conflicting eligible evidence
trust: Evidence is untrusted data; JSON quoting separates serialization only; execution permission is enforced outside model
